items.name: modsearch
items.desc: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.

items.name: dsh-free-search
items.desc: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.

items.name: dsh-verify
items.desc: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.

items.name: dsh-tavily#packages/dsh-tavily
items.desc: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.

items.name: dsh-web-search-pro
items.desc: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.

items.name: dsh-chrome
items.desc: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.

items.name: dsh-tavily
items.desc: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.

items.name: dsh-pilot
items.desc: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.

items.name: dsh-jiey-browser
items.desc: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.

items.name: dsh-preview
items.desc: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.

items.name: dsh-searxng
items.desc: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.

items.name: dsh-web-search-exa
items.desc: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search-metaso
items.desc: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search
items.desc: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.

items.name: dsh-exa-mcp
items.desc: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.

items.name: dsh-s1
items.desc: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.

items.name: dsh-web-search-firecrawl
items.desc: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.

items.name: dsh-read-url
items.desc: Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA rendering, batch reads and site crawling.

items.name: dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
items.desc: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.

items.name: dsh-annotate
items.desc: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.

items.name: dsh-scrape-webpage
items.desc: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.

items.name: dsh-plugin-tavily
items.desc: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.

items.name: dsh-pilot
items.desc: Zero-dependency browser control: drive a real headless Edge/Chrome over CDP with 8 `pilot_*` tools (navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - text-first snapshots for text-only models, no Playwright, no API key.

items.name: dsh-cloak-browser
items.desc: CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.

items.name: dsh-browser-control
items.desc: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.

items.name: dsh-kimi-webbridge
items.desc: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.

items.name: chrome-faithful#dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful
items.desc: Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port.

items.name: dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http
items.desc: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.

items.name: dsh-video-downloader
items.desc: Detect and download media from Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Xiaohongshu with quality and format analysis.

items.name: browser-automation
items.desc: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.

items.name: dsh-plugin-search
items.desc: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.

items.name: dsh-cdp-browser
items.desc: CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.

items.name: dsh-image-search
items.desc: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.

items.name: dsh-websearch
items.desc: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.

items.name: dsh-moli
items.desc: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified on Windows and Linux.

items.name: dsh-inpage-translator
items.desc: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.

items.name: dsh-web-tools
items.desc: Unified multi-provider web search and fetch: BYOK key pools, health monitoring, and deterministic fallback.

items.name: dsh-firecrawl
items.desc: Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.

items.name: dsh-inapp-browser
items.desc: Shared browser panel for DeepSeek Harness via Better Sidebar, with local Chromium, human and agent mouse and keyboard control, page snapshots, screenshots, and per-chat persistent profiles.

items.name: dsh_use_browser#use-browser
items.desc: Generic browser automation with six tools (browser_open, browser_click, browser_type, browser_extract, browser_screenshot, browser_eval), @e element references, and dual Playwright-headless / CDP (connect to your own Chrome) backends.

items.name: dsh-tavily-web
items.desc: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.

items.name: dsh-connectors#browser-connector
items.desc: Browser automation connector: drives the local Edge or Chrome over the DevTools Protocol with zero runtime dependencies — launch a headless throwaway-profile browser or attach to one started with --remote-debugging-port, then navigate, read page text and interactive elements, click, type, and screenshot through 11 agent tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-webrelay
items.desc: Embeds external AI chat sites in a DSH side panel through the same-origin reverse proxy with per-site DOM adapters, and adds a composer button that either rewrites the draft with the host model or runs a two-round loop: compress the conversation, optimize, send to the embedded site, capture the reply, then finalize it into the composer.

items.name: dsh-web-window-companion
items.desc: Opens the dsh web GUI in a dedicated Edge/Chrome app-mode window on its own browser profile and gracefully stops the server when that window is closed.

items.name: dsh-plugins#reference-library
items.desc: Adds CodePen, Pinterest, Z-Library, and GitHub data cards to the native @ reference menu, with Pinterest pagination and Z-Library sorting.

items.name: web-search-advanced
items.desc: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.

items.name: dsh-browser-control
items.desc: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.

items.name: kimi-webbridge-dsh
items.desc: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-playwright
items.desc: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.

items.name: dsh-web-search-aggregation
items.desc: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Give the dsh agent a real browser: each conversation gets its own Chrome or Edge process with its own profile and CDP port, driven by six tools and mirrored live in the right sidebar, where you can watch the work and take over by clicking or typing on the picture. Nothing else to install — it uses the Chrome or Edge already on the machine, downloads no browser, needs no companion app or extension, and keeps its tabs and sign-ins between tool calls.

items.name: dsh-dschat
items.desc: Chat with the DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) in a native DSH panel — a real browser drives the site on your existing web login, with streaming replies, deep-thinking and smart-search toggles, and image or document attachments. Conversations can be recovered from the web side, exported as Markdown, and distilled or replayed into a harness session, and the agent reaches the same web chat through six tools (dschat_status, dschat_send, dschat_stop, dschat_recover, dschat_import, dschat_transfer).

items.name: dsh-free-search
items.desc: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.

items.name: dsh-plugins#web-fetch
items.desc: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.

items.name: dsh-plugins#web-search-searxng
items.desc: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.

items.name: dsh-web-annotator
items.desc: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch
items.desc: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.

items.name: dsh-free-web-search
items.desc: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.

items.name: dsh-browser-use
items.desc: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.

items.name: dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
items.desc: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

items.name: dsh-cdp
items.desc: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-browser-cdp
items.desc: Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.

items.name: dsh-web-search-microsoft-webiq
items.desc: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.

items.name: dsh-web-search-ext
items.desc: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.

items.name: qp-exa-dynamic
items.desc: Exa-backed web search provider for the ctx.web seam, with Exa Dynamic Highlights on by default and the Exa-Beta header that setting requires; exposes all eight Exa retrieval types, adds an /exa command to change highlights, search type and result count at runtime, and registers an exa_search tool that takes its own result count.

items.name: dsh-web-search-bing
items.desc: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).

items.name: dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
items.desc: Side-panel Chrome and Firefox extension that lets DSH drive the tab you are on: pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing and navigation wait for your approval. Beyond upstream it adds viewport screenshots, opening a URL in a new window, scrolling inside nested scroll containers (chat transcripts, side panes, modal bodies), permission-mode, model and slash-command controls in the composer, and an opt-in developer-tools group (elements and CSS, page JavaScript, network requests) that is off by default and approved per call. The install is two halves: the bridge plugin comes from the prebuilt release tarball, and the companion extension ships as a tgz in the same release and is loaded unpacked, which is the only way Chrome accepts it. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-moli
items.desc: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.

items.name: opencu
items.desc: Computer use with browser automation, approvals and annotations for DSH; full desktop UI and native monitoring require matching host source adapters, patching and a host build.

items.name: dsh-browser-agent
items.desc: 19 browser_* tools that let agents drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser over a loopback bridge: accessibility-tree reads with stable refs, real CDP clicks and keys, screenshots, network interception, device emulation, a cookie vault, document-start script injection, multiple browser instances, and raw CDP passthrough. Requires DSH launched with --remote-debugging-port=9222.

items.name: dsh-web-search-openai
items.desc: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.

items.name: dsh-opencli
items.desc: Logged-in browser automation with 170+ site adapters as deterministic one-shot commands (requires the OpenCLI CLI, npm i -g @jackwener/opencli, and its BrowserBridge browser extension) — action-evidence verification (no silent failures), site knowledge & health cards, watch monitoring, trace replay, provenance reports, and a write-approval gate.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Gives the agent a real headed Chromium under the harness home, with browser_open and browser_interact tools that keep page state across calls.

items.name: dsh-browser-agent#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Chrome side-panel browser agent for DeepSeek Harness with tools to inspect pages, navigate, click, type, scroll, and capture screenshots through a local bridge.

items.name: dsh-dschat
items.desc: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.

items.name: dsh-webchat
items.desc: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.

items.name: dsh-plugin-chrome
items.desc: A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.

items.name: dsh-web-recorder
items.desc: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-fakeip
items.desc: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.

items.name: dsh-keenable
items.desc: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.

items.name: dsh-web-kimi
items.desc: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.

items.name: dsh-web-search-doubao
items.desc: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.

items.name: dsh-web-search
items.desc: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.

items.name: dsh-browser-ops
items.desc: Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create test data on demand; ships 27 browser_* tools plus a Settings panel.

items.name: dsh-douyin-agent
items.desc: Browses Douyin videos in a dedicated Edge browser with configurable time limits, shared local persona and interest memory, native settings, and Markdown viewing reports. Messaging, sharing, greetings, and public comments each require separate opt-in permissions.

items.name: dsh-native-browser
items.desc: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.

items.name: dsh-web-search
items.desc: Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.

items.name: dsh-browser-tabs
items.desc: Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.

items.name: pi-control-chrome#dsh-tool-control-chrome
items.desc: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.

items.name: dsh-browser-service
items.desc: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.

items.name: dsh-moli-browser
items.desc: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.

items.name: dsh-search-hub
items.desc: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.

items.name: deepseek-harness-zhipu_plan_tools
items.desc: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.

items.name: dsh-tinyfish-search
items.desc: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.

items.name: dsh-plugin-browser
items.desc: Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.

items.name: dsh-browser-playwright-codex
items.desc: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.

items.name: hermes-web-mcp
items.desc: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.

items.name: dsh-gui-auth-url
items.desc: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.

items.name: dsh-web-search-glm
items.desc: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).

items.name: dsh-browser
items.desc: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.

items.name: dsh-chrome-bridge#plugin
items.desc: macOS only (native messaging); needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Controls the Chrome you are already logged into, over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 11 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows/Linux the plugin reports the macOS-only platform requirement instead of failing silently.

items.name: dsh-keyless-search
items.desc: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.

items.name: dsh-browser-plus
items.desc: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.

items.name: dsh-web-search-zhipu
items.desc: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.

items.name: dsh-browser4
items.desc: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.

items.name: dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-firecrawl
items.desc: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.

items.name: dsh-research-plugins#dsh-tavily
items.desc: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.

items.name: dsh-web-search-fetch
items.desc: Aggregated web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, sitting behind the built-in tools. Search fans one query out to AnySearch, Zhipu and Zhihu concurrently, dedupes URLs, fuses ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optionally reranks through SiliconFlow. Fetch is URL-aware: static pages pass through the built-in HTTP fetcher, dynamic ones fan out to Firecrawl and AnySearch extract and pick one body by quality. One shared circuit breaker skips an engine for the day after a quota or 429 signal, and a settings card keeps each engine API key in the credential store without ever showing its value.

items.name: dsh-webstack
items.desc: SearXNG search and Scrapling multi-tier fetch provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web with SSRF protection and markdown conversion.

items.name: dsh-web-search-tavily
items.desc: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.

items.name: dsh-browser-use
items.desc: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.

items.name: dsh-html-inspector
items.desc: Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.

items.name: dsh-browsercontrol-mcp
items.desc: Mounts Microsoft's Playwright MCP through the official dsh-mcp-client so the agent gets its browser tools over stdio; the one-time CDP authorization is guided by a prompt note, a call guard and the /bw-setup command.

items.name: dsh-doyourweb
items.desc: Reference already-open Chrome and Edge tabs with @ mentions in DSH; reuse login state to read pages, run batched actions, take screenshots and call WebMCP tools on supported pages through a paired browser extension.

items.name: dsh-web-search-ollama
items.desc: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.

items.name: dsh-tavily-pool
items.desc: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.

items.name: dsh-webmcp
items.desc: WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.

items.name: dsh-tabbit
items.desc: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.

items.name: better-crawler4agent
items.desc: Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.

items.name: browserskill#dsh-plugin-browserskill
items.desc: BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.

items.name: dsh-search-enhance
items.desc: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.

items.name: dsh-web-search-openrouter
items.desc: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.

items.name: dsh-dragon-control
items.desc: Windows x64 only, 0.5.3 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.

items.name: dsh-bing-search
items.desc: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.

items.name: dsh-web-fetch-fakeip-plugin
items.desc: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.

items.name: dsh-chrome-cdp
items.desc: Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.

items.name: dsh-jev-ultrafast
items.desc: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.

items.name: aginxbrowser#dsh-aginxbrowser
items.desc: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.

items.name: dsh_academic_web_proxy
items.desc: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.

items.name: dsh-browser-crossplatform#bridge
items.desc: Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the model read the tab you are on as text and act on it, with image recognition off until the user enables it.

items.name: browser-mcp
items.desc: Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-tavily-search
items.desc: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.

items.name: dsh-web-search-tavily
items.desc: Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.
